announcements.title: Rafi runs riot: 6–0 demolition of Farhan sends him into the Legacy semi-finals
announcements.body: Rafiul Hasan Rafi is the first player into the semi-finals of the eFootball Tournament Legacy after a ruthless 6–0 quarter-final win over Farhan Mahee. The strangest part? Farhan actually had more of the ball — 52% possession and more completed passes — but Rafi's Internazionale Milano were lethal where it mattered: 14 shots, 11 of them on target, and six goals. Farhan's goalkeeper made 6 saves on the night, and without him the margin could have been even heavier. A real statement win from Rafi, who now waits to see who joins him in the last four.
